findings.location: Paragraph beginning “If we are honest about the actual definition…”
findings.source_quote: many, if not most, of the ‘stories’ that are spreading through the rumor-mill are indeed conspiracy theories.

findings.translation_quote: nyingi, kama si nyingi sana, za ‘simulizi’ zinazoenezwa katika uvumi ni nadharia za njama kweli.
